entities.name: CGRP+ sensory nerve in subchondral bone

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2 levels in both the subchondral bone and cartilage following DMM surgery were almost normalized through celecoxib treatment

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.evidence_quote: mechanical hyperalgesia of the hind paw following DMM surgery was significantly prevented by celecoxib

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: capsaicin effectively attenuated the DMM-induced decrease in the 50% pressure withdrawal threshold, pressure threshold, and parameters of spontaneous activity

relationships.subject: EP4
relationships.evidence_quote: EP4−/− mice and celecoxib-treated mice showed an improvement in mechanical hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: celecoxib
relationships.object: CGRP+ sensory nerve in subchondral bone
relationships.evidence_quote: The calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP)+ sensory nerve in the subchondral bone demonstrated a five-fold increase in the vehicle-treated DMM group and a slight decrease in the celecoxib-treated DMM group

key_findings: Subchondral bone PGE2 rises early in DMM osteoarthritis (mainly osteoblast COX-2 derived); celecoxib, capsaicin denervation or sensory EP4 knockout attenuate bone changes, degeneration and pain.
